messages:
Grace Kim: Heads-up: starting 2026-09-01 we're consolidating personal card (pcard) usage for engineering travel. New rule: personal cards may only be used for incidental expenses under $100. All flight/hotel/registration must be booked on corporate card or via Concur PO. Please plan travel requests accordingly. Link: https://redwood.example.com/finance/pcard-update

Omar Santos: Quick Q  contractors traveling for onsite workshops, do they follow same card rules?

Grace Kim: Contractors on company time should use the corporate travel workflow and request a temporary vcard if they don't have a company card. Reimbursements for contractor-incurred travel are exception-only and require director approval.

TravelBot: Automated note: per-diem rates updated for North America: $70/day (meals) and $35/day (incidentals). International per-diems will be posted per-country in the travel policy doc. Receipts still required for expenses >$75.

Procurement Ops: For large group travel bookings (5+ people), start a group travel PO at least 21 days out. Procurement will negotiate group rates for hotels and can pre-pay if requested. Use `group-travel` tag in the Supplier Portal.

Omar Santos: If a team books a conference booth that includes travel for 6 people, should we do a group PO or split across teams?

Grace Kim: Use a single group PO and add `cost_center` for each attendee in the PO notes. Procurement will split invoices to GLs at invoice time if you provide `project_code` mapping.

FinanceLead: Reminder: pcard statement reconciliation must be completed within 5 business days of cycle close. Late reconciliations will trigger an audit hold and may pause future card issuance.

Omar Santos: Any grace period for the first cycle while teams adjust?

Grace Kim: Yes  first cycle after rollout has a 10-business-day reconciliation grace window. After that standard 5-day rule applies. We'll send weekly reminders during the transition.

Procurement Ops: Note: temporary travel vcards expire after 30 days. If you need an extension for multi-week travel, request a vcard refresh with justification.

TravelBot: Automated: expense templates for multi-attendee events are available at Console -> Templates -> Travel. Use those to ensure per-diems and meal caps are applied automatically.

Grace Kim: Thanks everyone. Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've read and confirm you'll update your teams. We'll host a 15-min AMA on Thursday 11am PT to walk through the new flow.
